proof_body:
by
  intro m n x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ p q hm hn hmn
  have hs : m - n ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hmn
  rw [eq_div_iff hs, eq_div_iff hs]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor <;> linarith
target_source: ∀ (m n x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ p q : ℝ), 0 < m → 0 < n → m ≠ n → ((n * (p - x₁) = m * (p - x₂) ∧ n * (q - y₁) = m * (q - y₂)) ↔ (p = (m * x₂ - n * x₁) / (m - n) ∧ q = (m * y₂ - n * y₁) / (m - n)))
